review_method: Read full v1 correction plus entire v1-to-v2 source/metric/schema/test delta. Verified all candidate/original/qualification/evidence hashes. Executed three independent synthetic arithmetic probes against exact v2 source; inspected all30 retained test results and all11 actual regenerated unrun-arm values. No model, compiler, checker, provider, human annotation or native API invoked.

resolved_finding.primary_rule: Primary numerator/value require a nonempty declared population and an admitted, independent-gold, definite boolean judgment for every eligible unit. Missing gold, null judgment and unrepresented eligible units remain unknown.
resolved_finding.coverage: Definite adjudication count/full eligible count and missing-unit count are explicit.
resolved_finding.lower_bound: Verified matches/full eligible population is a separate field with not_a_primary_estimate:true. Unknown units are not asserted failures.
resolved_finding.independent_negative_positive_proof: Missing-gold and null-judgment two-row fixtures both yield null primary,1/2 adjudication coverage and separately labeled0.5 lower bound. Fully adjudicated true/false control yields measured0.5 and2/2 coverage.

other_corrections_accepted: CPU observation independent from elapsed wall time
Explicit false bridge transfer preserved over aliases
Observed false-transfer failures counted without success admission; invalid/no-run/fixtures excluded
Finite/nonnegative numeric and strict canonical JSON guards
Normalized mappings explicitly do not qualify direct native benchmark report conversion
limits: This acceptance is for accounting source correction only; no scientific result, source provenance or independent human annotation is certified.

The frozen full population remains1913 units. No revised sample, denominator, weighting or group definition is introduced. Any future separately declared sample still requires prospective protocol/provenance review and retained human adjudication.
At least100 independently adjudicated natural units and20 source-family/time groups remain downstream study gates; synthetic bookkeeping fixtures do not satisfy them.

The primary metric conservatively remains unavailable when any eligible unit lacks an admitted definite independent judgment, including failed/unrun units; coverage/lower-bound diagnostics remain available.
Gold/proof flags are normalized input claims and must be checked against external evidence before actual results are admitted; count-only unrun recipes do not expose or validate heldout IDs.
All old completed task/receipt/snapshot histories remain immutable; source integration and fresh actual commands/native evidence are separate root operations.
